notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Update 1.0.3[/b][/u][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]New Content[/h3][p]- It is now possible to play with 5~15 players, however for the match to be counted as Ranked, there must still be at least 10 players.[/p][h3]
Cosmetics[/h3][p]- Added cosmetics (Nameplates) unlocked when the player owns certain AmongUs Challenger DLCs or achievements.[/p][p]- Added Season 1 Ranked Nameplates depending on the player’s current rank.
[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed a bug that prevented the game from launching.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Language[/h3][p]- Added and fixed certain translations in French / Simplified Chinese (Texts & Buttons)[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content: [h3][b][u]Update 1.0.2[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Security[/h3][p]- Improved the STEAM security system for error detection and detection of DLCs owned by the player.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed a bug that prevented DLC cosmetics from unlocking properly.[/p][p]- Fixed rank display in-game (ranks are no longer shown before the match starts).[/p][p][/p][h3]Language[/h3][p]- Added Simplified Chinese to the game.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b][u]Update 1.0.1[/u][/b][/h3][h3]
Security[/h3][p]- Improved security system for players using an incompatible version.[/p][p]- Enhanced protection against players joining an Among Us Ranked lobby via a vanilla client.
[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where some players were kicked when trying to join a new match after finishing a previous one.[/p][p]- Fixed some in-game text errors.[/p]

notes.title: Official Release of Among Us Ranked & Season 1 Starting
notes.content:
[p]
After a long beta-testing period, we are excited to announce the official release of [b]Among Us Ranked[/b]! 
A huge thank you to everyone who participated and helped improve the project during this testing phase.


[/p][h3] 🏆 Season 1 – Dates[/h3][list][*][p]Start[b]:[/b] [b]September 3, 2025[/b][/p][/*][*][p]End[b]:[/b] [b]December 31, 2025 

[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]-> [url="https://discord.gg/VehgUD6qAe"]Discord / Support[/url] 
-> [url="https://amongusranked.orianagames.com/leaderboards"]Leaderboard[/url] 
-> [url="https://amongusranked.orianagames.com/maps"]Maps[/url]  

[/h3][p][i]This game is the result of the hard work of a small and dedicated team of volunteer devs/modders.We’ve done our best to provide a stable and fun experience, but some bugs may still remain.
Please don’t hesitate to report any issues you encounter—your feedback is extremely valuable in helping us improve the game.
We’ll be releasing updates, bug fixes, and content regularly throughout the season.
Stay tuned—this is only the beginning of the adventure![/i][/p][p][/p][h3]
